first_impression.reaction: Intro is short and it tells me the range, 1839 to 2025, so I know it's recent. Good. But the key takeaways are about style families, not about any actual celebrity. I came for the rings, so I scrolled straight down to the numbered list. The numbered headings with names made that easy.

journey.quote: The 25 rings below run from a serpent ring given in 1839 to the old mine cut diamond announced in 2025.
journey.reaction: Nice, it goes up to 2025, so Taylor's ring is probably in here. That's what I wanted to know.

journey.quote: Every celebrity ring here belongs to a style family you can ask a jeweller for by name, from the emerald-cut solitaire to the toi et moi.
journey.reaction: Fine, but not one name in the takeaways. Give me 'the most copied is Diana's sapphire, the newest is Taylor Swift's' or something. I skipped this.

journey.quote: Carat weights appear only where the source pack supports them, and always as "reported as about X carats".
journey.reaction: What's a 'source pack'? Sounds like an internal note that got left in. The whole section is about how you wrote it, not the rings. I scrolled past.

journey.quote: You will notice there are no prices or valuations.
journey.reaction: Honestly, how much it cost is half of why people look these up. I get the reason, but I'd still want a ballpark.

journey.quote: An old mine cut is an antique style of diamond cutting, with a softer, chunkier sparkle than a modern round brilliant.
journey.reaction: This is the one I actually read. Who made it, what the cut is, and an explanation in plain words. Quick and useful.

journey.section: What these 25 rings teach us: the styles at a glance
journey.quote: Grouped by style family, the 25 rings narrow to eight looks.
journey.reaction: Love this table, I'd screenshot it. But it's way down after 25 photos. Put a link to it near the top.

journey.section: Wearing and photographing a statement ring at a destination wedding
journey.quote: A ring chosen at home meets a different set of conditions abroad: sun, sand, sunscreen, salt water and a long flight either side.
journey.reaction: Not why I'm here. I'm not getting married abroad, I was just curious about celebrity rings. Skipped.

unanswered_questions: Roughly how much are any of these rings worth? Even a reported figure for the famous ones.
When was this page last updated? Is anyone engaged in 2026 missing?
Is there a quick list of all 25 names near the top so I can jump to the one I care about?

turn_offs_found.quote: Where outlets disagree on a detail, we have left it out rather than choose between them.
turn_offs_found.why: Reassuring, but the whole 'How to read this list' section is three paragraphs of method before the first ring. On a phone that's fluff between me and the list.

turn_offs_found.quote: ## What these 25 rings teach us: the styles at a glance
turn_offs_found.why: The best summary on the page sits after 25 image slots. That's a lot of scrolling on a train before I get the scannable bit.

would_share_with: My group chat, with the Taylor Swift and Zendaya entries
A friend who keeps saving ring photos on Instagram

cta_reaction.quote: When you are ready to talk it through, [Wedded Concierge](/wonderland-concierge?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=internal&utm_campaign=celebrity-engagement-rings) is the place to start.

Put a jump list or a few big names (Diana/Catherine, Taylor Swift, Zendaya) in the key takeaways, and link to the 'styles at a glance' table from the top.
Add a visible 'last updated' date, and acknowledge the price question in one line rather than just saying there are no prices.
